title: NinjaTrader 8 – How to reliably link ATM child orders to their originating entry order?
text: Title: NinjaTrader 8 – How to reliably associate ATM child orders with their originating entry order using StartAtmStrategy()? Hello NinjaTrader Support Team, I am developing a custom NinjaScript indicator for NinjaTrader 8 that submits an entry order using Account.CreateOrder() and attaches a selected ATM template using NinjaTrader.NinjaScript.AtmStrategy.StartAtmStrategy() . The ATM template manages two contracts, with two profit targets and two stop-loss orders. I subscribe to Account.OrderUpdate and can successfully detect the order events, including Target1 being filled and Stop1 being cancelled. My challenge is identifying exactly which child orders belong to the specific ATM instance initiated by my indicator, without scanning historical account orders or accidentally including orders from other active ATM strategies. I would appreciate clarification on the following: Does StartAtmStrategy() expose an ATM instance identifier that can be associated with the originating entry order? Is there a supported property or API method to retrieve the child orders belonging to that particular ATM instance? Can the ATM instance, entry order, and its individual target/stop orders be reliably associated using an ATM ID, order references, OrderId , OCO IDs, or another supported mechanism? What is the recommended approach when multiple ATM strategies may be active on the same instrument and account? Can this association be maintained safely throughout order-state changes, partial fills, cancellations, and order modifications? My objective is to create an internal operation identifier and maintain a reliable one-to-one mapping with the ATM’s actual orders throughout the trade lifecycle. The indicator will only modify the remaining stop-loss order after Target1 has filled and its corresponding Stop1 has been cancelled. I am using simulated accounts only. Thank you for your guidance and any relevant documentation or code examples. 3 posts - 3 participants Read full topic
triage_reason: Trader needs to correctly associate ATM child orders in NinjaScript.
